text: うまいんだよなあ…　ふろあがりの　おみそしる！

structure.en: it's just so good, you know...

structure.jp: ふろあがりの　おみそしる！
structure.en: miso soup right after a bath!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ, which gives the feeling of 'the thing is...' or 'it really is so'. よなあ adds a dreamy 'isn't it just'. うまいんだよなあ = 'it really is so good, you know'.
